title: Minkä with a singular genitive noun
summary: Use minkä with a singular genitive noun: Minkä maan lippu tämä on? (“Which country's flag is this?”).
targetSkills: Minkä with a singular genitive noun
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
objectives: Use minkä with a singular genitive noun: Minkä maan lippu tämä on? (“Which country's flag is this?”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: Mikä (“which/what”) becomes minkä before a genitive noun. Minkä has the same form in singular and plural; the following noun expresses the number.
Use these noun models: maa → maan, koulu → koulun, talo → talon, auto → auton.
The question identifies a relationship: which country a flag belongs to, which school or house a part belongs to, or which car a key belongs to. The singular head noun keeps on.
keyPoints: Keep minkä unchanged for the requested number.
